comments.body:
Thanks @MayankTamakuwala for running it against your cases. Pushed a commit that addresses the points that reproduced:

- `set` now keeps only overlay keys and new keys on the overlay and forwards writes to existing Hono members (e.g. `ctx.res`) to the shared Context, as suggested.
- `ownKeys` / `getOwnPropertyDescriptor` merge the overlay in, so `{ ...ctx }` and `Object.keys(ctx)` include `method`, `params`, `auth` and `state` again.
- The test now also asserts the tool callback's result, so a failing callback no longer passes on status alone.

New tests cover the spread/keys case and the `ctx.res` write; both fail on the previous commit and pass now. Not done here: moving the overlay into `toRequestContext` (the callback context still writes `auth` onto the shared Hono Context). Your extra test file is welcome as a PR against this branch.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
Thanks for the quick turnaround. I checked `62f6e033` and everything passes on my side. I've opened the extra tests as a PR against your branch: https://github.com/pcbeingused333/mcp-use/pull/1
